column1: # Per-TF Fiber-seq footprint pads, in the MOTIF's own 5'->3' frame.
#   <tf>  <left>  <right>
# A TF absent from this file gets 0/0, i.e. today's unwidened behaviour.
# Read by make_meme_wide.py (sequence columns) and make_params_wide.py (Fiber vector),
# so the two layers cannot disagree about a TF's width.
# GENERATED -- do not hand-edit; see the header of each consumer.
# +/-150 on the 12 TFs with >=50 Rossi sites, i.e. those carrying an INDIVIDUAL Fiber-seq
# fit (abf1_reb1_dms_parameter_Fiber-seq_w_binom.py:54). Same TF set as tf_pads_wide10.tsv.
# MOTIVATION. At +/-200 the Fiber-seq accessibility profile around a motif is hyper-
# methylated (hyper-accessible) far past the motif edge; +/-10 cannot see that.
# The pad columns are sliced out of the 401-column pm200 refit
# (inputs/all_TFs_1000pealVal_params_pseudo_pm200bp.pkl, make_params_pm50.py --half 200).
# That refit bounds the pad: the widest motif here is 20 bp, sitting at [190,210), so the
# largest symmetric pad it can supply is +/-190. 150 leaves headroom on both sides.
# FRAME. Pads are in the motif's own 5'->3' frame, which for a MEME motif is the same thing
# as upstream/downstream on the Watson reference strand. robocop.py's reverse_complement
# mirrors them onto the reverse block; no strand flip is applied or wanted.
# 12 TFs x 300 extra columns = 3600 -> 7200 new states -> n_states 10685 (baseline 3485).
# tf                           left  right
